Name: The Lorax - Stats as Tokens bonus content
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Adds some letters and alternate dialog for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15012]The Lorax[/url] using Stats as Tokens. The Lorax will ominously count down how many truffula trees you've chopped down, congratulate you for your recycling efforts, comment on your goats, and more.

This bonus content pack uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9659]Stats as Tokens[/url], which is still in development. It is possible some of the stat counters will not work depending on the current status of SaT or if the method for calling stats has changed. If that happens and the Lorax's dialog for the day uses a stat, he simply won't talk. Likewise, if a stat is used to trigger sending a letter, that letter simply will not be mailed.

The dialog in this content pack will randomly replace the Lorax's 0- and 2-heart dialog about 2 out of 5 times. Because of the way the Lorax's dialog is set up, that means even if you have him at 10 hearts you may still see this dialog (but the chances are much lower because you may also see his 4-, 6-, 8-, or 10-heart dialog at that point).

[b]This mod is offered as-is. [/b]I will not be providing support for it unless there has been a major change to how SaT works that needs to be accounted for. If you are having difficulties using Stats as Tokens, please leave a comment on that mod's Nexus page. If you would like to try editing this mod to experiment with Stats as Tokens yourself, you are welcome to do so, but please do not upload those personal edits.
